columnDefinitions.description: Name must be unique within a namespace. Is required when creating resources, although some resources may allow a client to request the generation of an appropriate name automatically. Name is primarily intended for creation idempotence and configuration definition. Cannot be updated. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names#names
columnDefinitions.name: Name

columnDefinitions.description: The total number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod (including nodes correctly running the daemon pod). More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/daemonset/
columnDefinitions.name: Desired

columnDefinitions.description: The number of nodes that are running at least 1 daemon pod and are supposed to run the daemon pod. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/daemonset/
columnDefinitions.name: Current

columnDefinitions.description: numberReady is the number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod and have one or more of the daemon pod running with a Ready Condition.
columnDefinitions.name: Ready

columnDefinitions.description: The total number of nodes that are running updated daemon pod
columnDefinitions.name: Up-to-date

columnDefinitions.description: The number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod and have one or more of the daemon pod running and available (ready for at least spec.minReadySeconds)
columnDefinitions.name: Available

columnDefinitions.description: NodeSelector is a selector which must be true for the pod to fit on a node. Selector which must match a node's labels for the pod to be scheduled on that node. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/
columnDefinitions.name: Node Selector

columnDefinitions.description:
CreationTimestamp is a timestamp representing the server time when this object was created. It is not guaranteed to be set in happens-before order across separate operations. Clients may not set this value. It is represented in RFC3339 form and is in UTC.

Populated by the system. Read-only. Null for lists. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#metadata
columnDefinitions.name: Age

columnDefinitions.description: Names of each container in the template.
columnDefinitions.name: Containers

columnDefinitions.description: Images referenced by each container in the template.
columnDefinitions.name: Images

columnDefinitions.description: A label query over pods that are managed by the daemon set. Must match in order to be controlled. It must match the pod template's labels. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#label-selectors
columnDefinitions.name: Selector
